comparison.objective: Cut a copper tube at a mark without denting or spiraling the cut.
comparison.physical_skill: Incrementally feed a screw knob and repeatedly orbit/regrasp a cutter around a fixed tube.
comparison.success_condition: Full-depth circumferential cut on mark; bite >0.70 mm permanently fails, and spiral/off-square errors cap the score.
comparison.reason: Despite fine screw adjustment and iterative operation, the outcome is material cutting with controlled feed, not tuning a damper from dynamic stop measurements and relocking it.
